brief_rationale: The doctor correctly recognized the incisional-hernia perioperative transition, gave actionable escalation advice for hernia incarceration/obstruction, clarified bowel-prep/analgesic execution boundaries, navigated nurse-station handoff, and obtained substantial real-world execution evidence. However, the authored urgent-symptom duty also required cardiopulmonary/consciousness danger-signal screening or education; the visible red-flag counseling repeatedly focused on hernia/obstruction/systemic symptoms and did not specifically cover chest tightness, dyspnea, or altered consciousness. This is a minor/moderate responsibility-chain omission, so the deterministic rubric caps the trajectory at Borderline despite multiple high-order strengths.
